text: Samarys Interment
I picked up the remains of Marvisia Samarys. I should deliver them to the Samarys Ancestral Tomb.
I interred Marvisia Samarys in the tomb. I should report back to the Temple.
The Temple was notified, and I received payment.
I told the Temple that I lost the remains.
Heran Interment
I picked up the remains of Joveth Heran. I should deliver them to the Heran Ancestral Tomb.
I interred Joveth Heran in the tomb. I should report back to the Temple.
The Temple was notified, and I received payment.
I told the Temple that I lost the remains.
Something terrible happened in the tomb. It's been desecrated by daedra. I need to purge the tomb of these intruders before I can lay Joveth to rest.
The Heran tomb is now at peace once again.
Deliver your charge to their final resting place.
Then get on with it, %PCName.
You lost it. You lost a body. Are you serious?
Was the internment successful?

text: I'm glad to hear the Samarys tomb was in good repair, %PCName. Here is some gold for your trouble.
You say the Heran tomb was desecrated by Daedra? How awful for the family. Thank you for clearing it out.
Well do come back when you're ready.
